# watchOS

Every app in this list that runs on watchOS. That is 66 apps with 40 for Plex and 39 for Jellyfin and 14 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Official apps

- [Emby for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/app/id992180193) - iPhone and iPad app with Apple Watch and CarPlay support for Premiere users. `Emby` · `macOS` `iOS` `iPadOS` `CarPlay` `watchOS` · `Freemium`
